_doc.purpose: Default-deny allowlist of OpenRouter provider slugs. The user's rule (2026-09-06) is that their data never routes to China; the model alone decides nothing on OpenRouter, the serving PROVIDER does, so the provider set is pinned here and enforced by scripts/container/openrouter-guard.py -- not by any client setting a client could change.
_doc.enforced_by: scripts/container/openrouter-guard.py rewrites every completion request body's `provider` object before forwarding it to openrouter.ai. Clients never hold the real key; they hold a guard token and the guard's loopback base URL.

openrouter_fields.provider.only: string[] -- the ONLY providers allowed for the request. The guard sets this to [.allow[].slug] on every completion request, which is what makes the allowlist default-deny.
openrouter_fields.provider.allow_fallbacks: boolean, OpenRouter default true -- whether a backup provider may serve the request. Forced to false (.force.allow_fallbacks) so a failed allowlisted provider is an error, never a silent hop somewhere else.
openrouter_fields.provider.data_collection: "allow" | "deny", OpenRouter default "allow" -- forced to "deny" (.force.data_collection) so providers that may store prompts are skipped.
openrouter_fields.provider.order: string[] -- providers to try in order. A client-supplied order is KEPT only when every entry is in .allow; otherwise it is dropped and logged.
openrouter_fields.provider.ignore: string[] -- providers to skip. Not used: with provider.only set to the allowlist, everything else is already excluded. .deny below is documentation of WHY a host is out, and the source for the guard's log and the docs.

_doc.slug_source: Slugs are the `tag` prefix before '/' in https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<author>/<slug>/endpoints, cross-checked against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/providers (slug + headquarters + datacenters), verified 2026-09-06. `lambda` and `hyperbolic` were on the user's candidate list but no longer exist in the OpenRouter provider registry, so they are not listed; a slug that is not in the registry can never be selected anyway.
_doc.country: The country a request's prompt is processed in, as far as it can be established from the provider's headquarters and declared datacenters. A provider with no establishable country is NOT allowed -- absence of evidence is denial here.

allow.name: DigitalOcean
allow.note: US company (New York); the OpenRouter registry leaves its headquarters field blank.

deny.name: Z.AI
deny.reason: Zhipu AI, Beijing; the OpenRouter registry lists a Singapore entity, which does not change who operates it. Serves GLM first-party.

deny.name: Alibaba
deny.reason: China-based host; the registry lists SG headquarters with SG and CN datacenters.

deny.name: SiliconFlow
deny.reason: China-based host (Beijing); the registry lists a Singapore entity.

deny.name: Novita
deny.reason: Registry self-reports a US headquarters but declares no datacenter; GPU capacity is resold across regions and the serving location cannot be verified. Denied by default (user list, 2026-09-06).

deny.name: AtlasCloud
deny.reason: Registry self-reports a US headquarters but declares no datacenter; serving location cannot be verified. Denied by default (user list, 2026-09-06).

deny.name: GMICloud
deny.reason: Registry self-reports US headquarters and a US datacenter, but the company also operates Asia-Pacific capacity and the per-request location cannot be verified. Denied by default (user list, 2026-09-06).

deny.name: Phala
deny.reason: Decentralised (TEE) compute network: the physical host of any one request is not knowable in advance. Denied by default.

deny.name: Chutes
deny.reason: Decentralised (Bittensor) compute network: the physical host of any one request is not knowable in advance. Denied by default.

deny.name: Inceptron
deny.reason: Registry lists a Swedish company with a Finnish datacenter, but it is not on the user's verified list and GLM capacity there is new. Denied by default (user list, 2026-09-06); an allow candidate if verified later.

deny.name: Ambient
deny.reason: Registry declares neither headquarters nor datacenter. Denied by default.
